video_title: Valenslime | READ ALOUD | Making Slime at end
description:
A young slime scientist's efforts to make a Valentine's Day friend for her slime explode in this clever and funny picture book! Written and illustrated by Joy Keller and Ashley Belote.

SLIME RECIPE:
4 ounce bottle of clear glue or glitter glue
3 tablespoons multi-purpose contact solution
2 teaspoons baking soda
1 cup hot water from tap
*Mix baking soda and hot water. Let cool to room temperature.
*Mix glue and contact solution.
*Add room temperature mixture just 1 tablespoon at a time (you won't use the whole cup!) until it gets to the consistency you want!
ENJOY!
*Tip: If using regular glue you can add food coloring and/or glitter to the mixture if you want!
